tagline.zh: 灯一亮，镂空的彩色皮影贴着幕布上场；到了转折处，人影离幕，化作满台巨影
tagline.en: The lamp comes up and pierced, glowing leather puppets play your story on the screen; at the turn, a figure lifts away into a giant shadow
